fusions.name: False Lead
fusions.desc: Flicks a decoy bolt that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to turn it against its allies for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Pocket Check
fusions.desc: A light-fingered cut that deals 18 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds, then draws out every affliction you have on it, dealing 50% more damage for each one drawn.

fusions.name: Borrowed Shadow
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 6 seconds, and you move 15% faster while it holds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Loaded Dice
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
